 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Real American Freestyle (RAF) is ostensibly a wrestling promotion, but where they really excel is brawls, scuffles, and brouhahas .
 The latest commotion occurred on Thursday at the RAF 14 pre-fight press conference. Predictably, the chaos was centered around jiu-jitsu black belt and frequent nuisance Dillon Danis , who really has no other reason to be on a wrestling mat but to cause trouble. Danis unveiled his shirt that read "Khamzat is my b—ch" at the presser. When Khamzat Chimaev and Dillon Danis actually went head-to-head at RAF 10, "Borz" pinned him in 44 seconds , so the shirt doesn't make much sense. Still, it was enough to send notorious hothead Arman Tsarukyan apoplectic, and the top-ranked Lightweight went ballistic in defense of his close friend and training partner (see all that here) .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Where was Khamzat himself during all the chaos? New footage reveals that Chimaev was being restrained by about four people who appear to be a mix of RAF staff and civilians! "Borz" was desperate to get a piece of Danis and yelled out, "You don't know who is your daddy b—ch! I'll f—k you up!"
 Check it out:
 While Danis and Tsarukyan will wrestle (and then probably brawl again) in the RAF 14 main event, Chimaev is also booked to compete. In the co-main event, he'll take on former UFC Welterweight champion Robbie Lawler in a strange matchup that would seem to guarantee another dominant victory for the Russian.
 How about a little more challenge and a little more chaos?
